## History

Irving moved from [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to reside with his grandmother, Mrs. Irving. He was once involved in a long-ago romance and quarrel with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). Years later, his son [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) formed a fond friendship with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and Irving ultimately married her in an intimate garden ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before the couple departed from the station.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P17](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0017), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), +3 more_

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--lavendar-lewis.md)

Irving rekindled his long-ago romance with [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) after [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) introduced her to his son, leading to them walking together in the woods and courting. The two eventually married in an intimate garden ceremony held in the honeysuckle arbor at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) remains a close friend and confidante to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), welcoming her for visits where they discuss life and romance.

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P17](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0017), +13 more_

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--paul-irving.md)

[Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) is Irving's son. [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) formed an immediate, fond friendship with [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) after being introduced to her by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) prior to his father's marriage to her.
